title: Visual Planning: Let's Think Only with Images

layout.note: Three horizontal lanes stacked top to bottom, each with a centred title and the same Input-to-output chain on shared columns; a small two-swatch key sits above the first lane; contents of the steps hang under the boxes.

lesson: Compare paradigms by drawing each as the same Input-steps-Output chain on its own lane and letting colour carry the single difference (blue text boxes versus purple image boxes), with a two-swatch key in the corner and the content of each step written or pictured under its box.
